acceptance_results.evidence: premium-task, release-gate and direct pytest share one lock file. pytest children own the lock through the database fixture; runners lock only non-pytest database commands with no parent/child deadlock. The lock identity uses RAVEL_TEST_DB with host/port from env > .env > defaults; the shared directory comes from Git's common dir; an unwritable directory fails hard. Process-local reentrancy handles composed session fixtures while external processes still wait/refuse. The independent re-review approved after the P1/P2/P3 fixes; final P3 cleanup was independently traced.

findings.impact: live-research fixture chain would fail once it reached database

findings.trigger: task-level database default omitted from per-command decision
findings.impact: an undeclared non-pytest database command could run without the lock while the manifest said locked
findings.required_fix: Fixed: needs_database_declared distinguishes an explicit false from the task default.

findings.trigger: host/port identity split between exported env and .env
findings.impact: two locks for the same test database when .env is customized
findings.required_fix: Fixed: env > repo .env > defaults, matching Settings; test DB name stays RAVEL_TEST_DB.

findings.trigger: old evidence bound to pre-redesign code
findings.impact: claims not tied to reviewed code
findings.required_fix: Fixed: new artifact binds 0e8994b/digest ec07e0ba and a fresh cross-WSL/container refusal; final gates at 183828/184042.

findings.trigger: interrupt between process-local depth and return
findings.impact: later locks could bypass flock in the same process
findings.required_fix: Fixed at 31a7205; the except path unwinds the depth and closes the handle.

residual_risks: The new declaration test pins normalize_command, not the run_task branch itself; that branch is verified by inspection.
Heuristic boundary: a shell wrapper that starts pytest indirectly takes the parent lock while the pytest child waits. No current premium task or gate row has that shape.
Windows-native msvcrt and POSIX flock are different mechanisms; the proven crossing is WSL-host to Linux container.
A relative RAVEL_PREMIUM_LOCK_DIR resolves against each process's cwd; internal callers use absolute paths.
The release-gate CERTIFIED result is the single research-readback row; the full gate remains open under BLOCKERS.md B03.
